<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildCustomMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Building" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop the basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give sets to the children"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildAndTest" name="Build and test each subcomponent">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart_BuildSubcomponent" name="Start subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent using sorted parts"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContainerEmpty" name="Container empty?" default="Flow_ContainerNotEmpty"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestSuccessful" name="Test successful?" default="Flow_TestUnsuccessful"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_SubcomponentTested" name="Subcomponent test successful"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubStartToBuild" sourceRef="SubStart_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToContainerCheck" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_ContainerEmpty"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContainerEmpty" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContainerEmpty" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${containerEmpty}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContainerNotEmpty" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContainerEmpty" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderToBuild" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToDecision" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestSuccessful" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful" targetRef="SubEnd_SubcomponentTested">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${testSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestUnsuccessful" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSuccessful" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RedesignToBuild" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble the subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineAssembled" name="Machine assembled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDesign" sourceRef="StartEvent_Building" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignToOrder" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToGive" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiveToSort" sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SortToBuild" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToAssemble" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTest" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleToEnd" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
